from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitation(BaseModel):
    """Information about one paper and its outgoing citation edges found in its bibliography."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    citations: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of papers referenced in this document's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Schema for parsing a single document for citation chain construction."""
    papers: list[PaperCitation]
